sentences.text: Dreamer is a 2005 American sports drama film written and directed by John Gatins in his directorial debut .	John Gatins	John Gatins	sports	sports film	drama film	drama film	directorial debut	List of directorial debuts

The film stars Kurt Russell , Kris Kristofferson , Elisabeth Shue and Dakota Fanning .	Kurt Russell	Kurt Russell	Dakota Fanning	Dakota Fanning	Kris Kristofferson	Kris Kristofferson	Elisabeth Shue	Elisabeth Shue
It is inspired by the true story of an injured Thoroughbred racehorse named Mariah 's Storm .	Thoroughbred	Thoroughbred	racehorse	horse racing

The film premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on September 10 , 2005 and was theatrically released on October 21 , 2005 by DreamWorks Pictures .	DreamWorks Pictures	DreamWorks Pictures	Toronto International Film Festival	Toronto International Film Festival
The film received mixed to positive reviews from critics , and earned $ 38 million on a $ 32 million budget .
It also received a Critics Choice Award nomination for Best Family Film .	Critics Choice Award	Critics Choice Award
